findings.reason: the deliverable's scope ("comments") excludes the glossary string rendered to Jev, so a worker following it literally would leave a false definition in the prompt that §15 and §18 together invalidated; naming the glossary entry changes both the plan text and the node's output.
findings.text: §18 renders `moved_off` on every pick, but its own deliverable corrects only the two comments, and the `_GLOSSARY["moved_off"]` entry at `reckon/crew/picker/prompts.py:129-134` still tells Jev the figure is "counted at this node's requirement" — which §15 made false for the no-requirement case this section exists to serve, so Jev would be shown a count under a definition that denies what the count does

rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §18's evidence is a repository test (`tests/test_a_move_counts_against_the_pick.py`, `tests/test_picker_helpers_have_one_owner.py`) plus the run's own gate logs under the run directory; nothing is written to a session scratchpad or node-local temporary path.
